{{Quote|His power core is unique, a rare piece from a lost alien civilization. Fully charging it was beyond the abilities of the Republic's pathetic scientists.|Zardres|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An [[Alien/Legends|alien]] '''power core''' was utilized by [[Project Ignition]] for the prototype [[M1-4X]] Advanced War Droid after the technology was recovered by [[Havoc Squad]] on a [[Mission to Ando Prime|mission]] to [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]].
